100% Transparent Dynamic Pricing Formula

We believe in zero hidden fees. Every order follows our standard pricing equation:

Step 1: Total USD
total_usd = amount + issuance_fee
            + (amount * funding_fee%)
            + processing_fee
Step 2: Price in NPR
price_npr = total_usd * exchange_rate
            * (1 + commission_percent / 100)
Rounded to nearest rupee
